# COMP3020 Group Project - Bluesky: "climate change" vs "climate crisis"
# Text Analysis & Visualisation
# Written by: Pushti Patel

library(tm)
library(SnowballC)
library(ggplot2)
library(wordcloud)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# Load cleaned posts
posts <- readRDS("posts_clean.rds")

# ---- Step 1: Prepare text ----
corpus <- Corpus(VectorSource(posts$text))

# Clean text (COMP3020 standard pipeline)
corpus <- tm_map(corpus, content_transformer(function(x) iconv(x, to = "ASCII")))
corpus <- tm_map(corpus, tolower)
corpus <- tm_map(corpus, removeNumbers)
corpus <- tm_map(corpus, removePunctuation)
corpus <- tm_map(corpus, stripWhitespace)
corpus <- tm_map(corpus, removeWords, stopwords("english"))
corpus <- tm_map(corpus, stemDocument)

# ---- Step 2: Create Term Document Matrix ----
tdm <- TermDocumentMatrix(corpus)
m <- as.matrix(tdm)

# Word frequencies
word_freq <- sort(rowSums(m), decreasing = TRUE)
freq_df <- data.frame(
  word = names(word_freq),
  freq = word_freq
)

# ---- Visualisation 1: Frequent Words (Bar Chart) ----
top20 <- freq_df |> head(20)

ggplot(top20, aes(x = reorder(word, freq), y = freq)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Top 20 Most Frequent Words",
       x = "Word", y = "Frequency")
       
# ---- Visualisation 2: Word Cloud ----
set.seed(123)
wordcloud(
  words = freq_df$word,
  freq = freq_df$freq,
  min.freq = 10,
  min.words = 200,
  random.order = FALSE,
  rot.per = 0.25,
  colors = brewer.pal(8, "Dark2")
)

)
